summary: Iteration 3 testing of g00dweird.com (5 new rooms with bg_url, quote-bubble, persistent thought-bubble via *think prefix, mobile-responsive layout). Backend: 32/32 pytest tests PASSED (14 iter1 regression + 11 iter2 + 7 new iter3). Frontend Playwright desktop + mobile flows all functional: room bg renders from customer-assets URL, quote-bubble appears on chat send, toggle-think prefixes input, thought-bubble appears on *think and clears with bare *think, mobile-actions bar with all 6 m-* buttons works, drawer toggles, sprite-picker / jukebox-window open via mobile buttons, chat-window spans full 390px viewport, chat-input fits without overflow, desktop icon column hidden on mobile.

integration_issues.issue: m-share button click did not surface an element with [data-testid='copy-invite-toast'] in mobile run. Either toast uses a different testid or the toast was dismissed faster than 800ms. Desktop copy-invite already validated in iter2. Minor.

action_items: Optional: add [data-testid='copy-invite-toast'] (or document the existing testid) to the toast that briefly shows after m-share / copy-invite is clicked, so it can be asserted in tests.

Optional polish: when a room is switched on mobile via m-worlds + WorldPicker, ensure the chat window title bar refreshes to the new room name (observed it occasionally still showed [ HELLO ] briefly after picking JELLO; chat does refocus, but title-bar text update was not always immediate). Likely a re-render race; non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is approaching ~720 lines; consider splitting WS handler (chat/typing/move/avatar/sprite/jukebox) into dedicated module for readability and testability. Same recommendation as iter2 still applies.

ClientConn.last_message has no TTL on the server side — it persists for the lifetime of the WS connection. The 8s expiry is purely client-side. New joiners receive last_message in the snapshot regardless of age; if a user has been idle for >8s their bubble may flash on a new joiner's screen until 8s passes since last_message.ts. Consider stripping last_message older than 8s in room_user_list() to keep client+server semantics consistent.

*think parsing does not handle 'think' inside legitimate chat (rare but possible: '*think* I was right'). Current code only strips when prefix is exactly '*think ' or equal to '*think', which is correct, but document this for users.
Direct type:'thought' WS event has no length cap separate from the 200-char clamp in chat path; both paths clamp to 200, which is consistent.
Mobile chat window uses 100vw x calc(100dvh - 34px). 100dvh is well-supported now but degrades on older mobile Safari (<15.4). Acceptable for retro-themed app.
WorldPicker on mobile is not auto-opened, but the active room indicator inside it relies on currentRoomId prop; verify it's passed when opened via m-worlds (it is — Desktop.jsx passes it; OK).

Iter3 covers 5-rooms+bg_url, *think intercept, last_message snapshot field, type:'thought' event, user_joined sprite/x/y. Frontend: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is the public preview URL. rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Two minor observations: (1) copy-invite-toast testid not found after m-share click on mobile — likely missing/different testid; (2) chat title-bar may briefly lag when switching rooms via WorldPicker on mobile, harmless render race. Server-side last_message has no age cap (purely client-side 8s) — see code review #2.
